default: Good trade to review. Walking your process: the London sweep into sell-side liquidity gave you the reason to look long, and the 15m BOS confirmed the shift in structure — that's a clean read of HTF bias and intent. Your entry on the FVG/order-block retest was the right model; the only slack was taking it a touch before the gap fully filled, which widened your stop. Risk was defined before entry and held under 1%, and you stayed patient with the runner — that's the discipline that compounds. For the next one: anchor entry to the completed FVG fill, and pre-plan a scale-in level so the runner is sized on purpose rather than by feel. This is post-trade reflection only — I'm reviewing what you did, not calling the next move.
